'''Rulebooks''' are the rules documents for ''Star Wars'' CCG across every era this wiki covers. Decipher published rule booklets, a Glossary, a Glossary Supplement, and expansion rulesheets. The Players Committee later published Advanced Rulebooks for Virtual Legacy and for current Virtual play.

'''This wiki supports playing all eras''' - Decipher constructed, Legacy Virtual (pre-2014 Reset), and current Virtual / Players Committee tournament play. Use the chronological bands below to pick the rules document that matches the cards and format you are playing.

This page is the PDF library and transcription index. Files are cited to the [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/index.html Decipher rules index] (archive) and, where a working copy still serves, to [https://www.starwarsccg.org/rules/ starwarsccg.org/rules/].

== 1. Decipher ==

Core printed rules and expansion rulesheets from Decipher (1995-2001). No Players Committee modifications.

=== Decipher core documents ===

These three are the last widely used Decipher core rules. Glossary 2.0 told players to discard all rules documents dated before November 1998. The Glossary Supplement is the later official companion (Decipher called it the CRD companion to Glossary 2.0).

The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game compiled Premiere rules with selected A New Hope and Hoth supplements: [[Media:Decipher_ESB_Two_Player_Rules.pdf|esb2prules.pdf]].

A Spanish-language Premiere Two-Player booklet was prepared for a Spanish SWCCG release that was later cancelled: [[Spanish Premiere Two-Player Game rules booklet]] ([[Media:Spanish_Premiere_Two-Player_Game_rules_booklet.pdf|PDF]]). Language editions are on [[Translations of SWCCG]].

== 2. Legacy Virtual ==

Era overview: [[History of the Players Committee]]; pre-reorg sets: [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]].

Players Committee rules used with '''Virtual Legacy''' cards (2002 through the 2014 Reset). These are '''not''' Decipher publications and are '''not''' the current tournament Advanced Rulebook.

{| class="wikitable"
! Document
! Wiki
! PDF
|-
| Advanced Rulebook 2.0 (Legacy Virtual era)
| [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]] (redirect: [[Legacy Virtual Advanced Rulebook]])
| [[File:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf]] - also [https://web.archive.org/web/20150807023558/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf Wayback archive]
|}

AR 2.0 introduced the [[Mission]] card type and other Virtual Legacy-era revisions. Use it when playing or researching pre-Reset PC virtual cards. Do '''not''' use it as a substitute for the 2023 Advanced Rulebook in current tournament play.
